evals.name: define-listing
evals.prompt: Publish an author's public name without publishing their internal review.
assertions: Declares the public listing with Public and its EventStore origin.
Omits private review details from the listing.
Selects the public listing explicitly on the consumer subscription.

evals.name: write-listing
evals.prompt: Write the producer side of publication after review acceptance.
evals.expected_output: Two sequenced appends with separate results.
assertions: Appends the internal review to the producer log.
Stops on an unsuccessful internal append.
Appends the public contract to the outbox with the same AuthorId and checks its result.

evals.name: verify-inbox
evals.prompt: Check which record arrived after the author listing was published.
assertions: Selects the directory's library inbox using EventSequenceId.InboxPrefix.
Checks the correct author ID and public name.
Does not claim the consumer received the private review.
